abstract: Malignant teratoma of the thyroid gland was found in a 19-year-old female. She was given a combined surgical and irradiation treatment. The tumor was 5.0X4.0X3.6 cm and located in the lower right lobe of the thyroid gland. Light and electron microscopical examination revealed mature or immature derivatives of the three primordial germ layers. The dominant portion of the tumor was composed of numerous masses of cancerous epithelial cells, which were distributed randomly in the mesenchymal tissue. Tumor cells invaded and replaced the surrounding thyroid tissue with occasional tumor thrombi in the lumens of blood vessels. No metastatic tumor was found in the lymph nodes. The patient was given a course of external irradiation, a total dose of 4000 rads, to the right thyroid area. Eight months after surgery, she is well and without any evidence of recurrence or metastasis.
abstract_ja: 甲状腺の悪性奇形腫が19歳女性に認められた。腫瘍は5.0×4.0×3.6cmで、甲状腺右葉下部に位置していた。光顕および電顕検査で三胚葉の成熟または未熟な成分が認められた。腫瘍の大部分は、間葉組織中にランダムに分布する多数のがん性上皮細胞の塊で構成されていた。腫瘍細胞は周囲の甲状腺組織に浸潤して置換し、血管内腔に腫瘍塞栓を伴うことがあった。リンパ節に転移は認められなかった。患者は右甲状腺領域に総量4000 radsの外照射を受けた。術後8か月の時点で、患者は元気で、再発や転移の所見はない。
